SRC-012:R001.text: CORE-001: editor snapshot failure (None sentinel) is non-destructive across cache, commit, navigation and Sync; legitimate empty text remains valid.

SRC-012:R002.text: CORE-002: a timed-out global QThreadPool drain can never retire state or release the ownership mutex; shutdown is fail-closed.

SRC-012:R003.text: CORE-003: editor and SiloRow rapid MiddleButton press/double-click/press behavior is permanently pinned by regression tests.

SRC-012:R004.text: W2-001: automatic startup can never kill a live mutex owner merely for missing IPC ACK; no-ACK yields UNRESPONSIVE and the newcomer exits.

SRC-012:R005.text: W2-002: sound teardown failures are exception-contained and cannot bypass canonical final persistence; unclean sound shutdown retains the mutex.

SRC-012:R006.text: W2-003: Codex child cleanup only unregisters confirmed-dead processes; service shutdown cannot report clean with a surviving registered child/reader.

SRC-012:R007.text: PERF-001: packaged long-sound replacement has no caller-side 500ms polling/sleep; latest-wins/no-replay semantics retained.

SRC-012:R008.text: PERF-002: QSoundEffect players and the 15ms poll timer have bounded physical lifetimes (no monotonic QObject residue or idle wakeups).
